name: Carousel
description: A horizontally scrollable strip of cards that snaps to each slide, with optional arrow links.
whenToUse: Testimonial strips, product or menu galleries, case-study rails, logo-plus-quote rows — when the user asks for a carousel, slider, swipeable row or horizontal scroller. USE THIS INSTEAD OF A JS SLIDER: it is CSS scroll-snap, so it publishes with ZERO JavaScript and keeps native drag, wheel, trackpad and keyboard scrolling plus mobile momentum. It SCROLLS BUT DOES NOT AUTO-ADVANCE — an autoplaying carousel needs a timer, so if the request genuinely requires autoplay, write it as a section with the @hydrate tag instead. NOT for a full-bleed hero slideshow, and not for content that must all be visible at once (use a grid).
